title: Audit review, centralized analysis and time correlation need operating evidence
remediation: Deployment monitoring and incident response owners approve review cadence, review triggers, reporting recipients, and the sources and clock tolerance for a system-wide trail. Component maintainers provide redacted event samples. Demonstrate central review, correlation across repositories and automated routing of a harmless test event to the approved response process. Record measured clock tolerance, owner review and follow-up, then assign and retest coverage gaps.

milestones.title: Collect approved review and source settings, a time-correlated multi-source record and a documented alert handoff and review
